run_bc_training_loop: run the behavior cloning training loop on BSuite with configurable learning rate and batch size
create_bc_learner: create a BCLearner with a logp loss function, Adam optimizer, and sharded prefetching dataset iterator
build_evaluator_network: build an evaluator network that applies epsilon-greedy sampling to the BC policy network output
setup_environment_loop: setup an EnvironmentLoop with a GenericActor and TerminalLogger to evaluate BC agent episodes
create_variable_client: create a VariableClient to sync policy variables between the BCLearner and GenericActor on CPU
